note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated India customs export records (23–28 Feb 2026) from Nashik/Janori ICDs to Rotterdam, Netherlands, all under HS 08061000 (fresh grapes), each with a distinct bill-of-lading number. Declared HS set 070999;080610;081090;200820 is only partially matched by observed records — the actual shipments seen are exclusively 080610 (fresh grapes); no records seen for 070999, 081090 or 200820, so those codes remain unverified rather than wrong. Per project rule 3, HS mismatch is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base with the observed code 08061000 recorded as factual. Role appears to be exporter/trader of fresh produce (consignments to 'TO THE ORDER OF', i.e. negotiable B/L, typical of merchant exporters) — role classification left to the registry team. Revenue and export volume in value/tonnage terms: null — ImportKey free view exposes counts and dates but no values, and no public financials were retrievable. Caveat on identity: the slug 'deccan-edibles-pvt-ltd' rendered an empty shell while 'deccan-edibles-private-limited' carried the records; the Mumbai (Andheri East) address on the records page is consistent with a single entity, but CIN/PAN could not be confirmed from any accessible registry (zaubacorp 403), so PAN/CIN = null.
